# Kreatorkit

> A link-in-bio for creators that sells. One page for your links, product picks, email list, free classes and courses. Kreatorkit takes 0% of what you sell.

Website: https://kreatorkit.app
Sign up: https://app.kreatorkit.app/signup
Contact: kreatorkit.app@gmail.com

## What it does
- Link-in-bio pages, made from ready examples (link in bio, shop my picks, free guide, sell a course, free class). Each page can use any of six looks.
- Product picks: Amazon and YouTube links open in their own apps, not Instagram's browser.
- Email list and a WhatsApp community button. Download your list any time.
- Free class sign-ups with calendar reminders.
- Sell files and courses with 0% commission. Buyers pay into the creator's own payment account (Stripe) and get a private download or course page.
- Smart links that open the YouTube, Spotify or Amazon app, with tap stats by source and device.
- Schedule YouTube videos and Shorts, with a calendar.
- Works with AI tools through an API and MCP (for example from Claude).
- Coming: Instagram comment to DM (built, waiting on Meta's approval) and selling in India with UPI and Indian cards.

## Plans (per month)
- Free: 2 pages, 5 smart links, email list up to 100 people, free class sign-ups, 5 scheduled posts a month, small "Made with Kreatorkit" badge.
- Creator: Rs 299 founding price (Rs 499 after the founding seats), or $7 ($9). Unlimited pages, picks, links, list and YouTube scheduling, calendar reminders, full stats, no badge.
- Pro: Rs 999 founding price (Rs 1,499 after), or $19 ($29). Everything in Creator, plus selling files and courses at 0% commission, private course pages and the API/AI tools.
- Sign up free with no card. The first 100 creators who sign up get Pro free for life (early access). Paid plans open soon.

## FAQ

### Do you take a cut of my sales?
No. We take nothing from your sales. You pay a flat monthly plan, and buyers pay straight into your own payment account. The payment company's own fee (cards, UPI) applies, as it does everywhere.

### Do I need a card to sign up?
No. Sign up with just your email. The first 100 creators get Pro free for life. Paid plans open soon; nothing is ever charged unless you pick one and add a card yourself.

### When does Instagram comment to DM arrive?
It's built and waiting on Meta's approval for our app. We can't promise Meta's timing. Founding members get it at no extra cost the day it switches on.

### Can I sell from India?
Selling works today with Stripe for creators outside India. UPI and Indian cards are next. Your pages, list, classes and scheduling work everywhere now.

### What happens after 100 founding seats?
New creators pay the normal price (₹499 / ₹1,499). Founding members keep their price for as long as they stay subscribed.

### Is my data safe?
We use the official Instagram, YouTube and payment APIs, store keys encrypted, and never sell data. You can delete everything from Settings.
